name: Do I need primer before repainting interior walls?

mainEntity.name: Do I need primer before repainting interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your walls are clean, in good shape, and you’re using a similar color, you may not need primer everywhere. Primer is usually needed over patches, stains, glossy surfaces, or major color changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Primer is usually needed for patches, stains, glossy paint, or strong color changes, but not always for every wall.
